# nexus nginx

Verbs: get, start, stop, restart, reload

## Usage

```
nexus nginx [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for nginx
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus nginx get`](nexus_nginx_get.md) | Get nginx's status |
| [`nexus nginx reload`](nexus_nginx_reload.md) | Reload nginx |
| [`nexus nginx restart`](nexus_nginx_restart.md) | Restart nginx |
| [`nexus nginx start`](nexus_nginx_start.md) | Start nginx |
| [`nexus nginx stop`](nexus_nginx_stop.md) | Stop nginx |
